decision: Hold the steering committee bi-weekly on Tuesdays through general availability, with an extra session within 2 business days if any dimension turns RED
rationale: Bi-weekly matches the decision rhythm of a six-month project without weekly executive time; the RED trigger means a breach never waits up to two weeks for a decision
options_considered: Weekly steering; monthly steering; bi-weekly with a RED trigger (chosen)

decision: Defer CR001, the live-chat widget, to phase 2
rationale: At $60,000 and 20 days it would need more than the whole $40,000 contingency and would push the M4 pilot; live chat is outside the chartered scope
options_considered: Approve now; defer to phase 2 (chosen); reject

decision: Test the reset and order journeys against a stubbed identity provider until the IdentityCo sandbox returns, then repeat them against the real provider before acceptance
rationale: Keeps the team on its sprint goal and protects the M4 pilot date with no baseline change; stub results are not acceptance evidence, so the real-provider repeat (AI003) is mandatory
options_considered: Pause the SSO-dependent stories until the sandbox returns; test against a stub and repeat later (chosen)
decided_by: Ben Adeyemi with Ava Chen (product owner)

decision: Approve CR003, the WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility uplift, with conditions: $12,000 from the contingency reserve and 2 more days on the Self-service UI task
rationale: Cheaper overall than a partial uplift, keeps the launch compliant, and fits the contingency because the accessibility gaps are risk R002 materialising. Condition: the audit runs in parallel with UAT preparation so no milestone moves
options_considered: Do nothing; full uplift now (chosen); uplift password reset only now and the rest after GA

decision: Defer DEC002 (approve IdentityCo's recovery plan; decide whether to draw management reserve for the 1.3.1 overrun) to the 2026-07-14 steering committee
rationale: The crash option was not yet costed, so any reserve figure would be a guess; two weeks stays inside the decide-by date, and the recovery plan's first milestone (sandbox back by 2026-07-06) shows whether IdentityCo is delivering
options_considered: Decide now on the recovery plan alone; defer two weeks with a costed crash option from Sam Lee (chosen)
